summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary was awarded a five-year IDIQ contract by the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency to supply up to 2,876 metric tonnes of high-purity vanadium pentoxide (max $125M). The contract is a routine commercial supply agreement, not a special situation (M&A, activist, restructuring, etc.). The filing reports operational news—a government supply contract—without any change of control, capital event, or strategic review. No deal terms (price per share, premium, etc.) are applicable.
